name: DC-005 OC-002 — GS01 End-to-End Content Production Workflow
description: Orchestrates the full DC-003 I030-I034 content production pipeline for GS01: Content Ingestion, Editorial Package, Social Media Package, Production Package, and live Carousel Rendering, with three CEO approval gates and Production Asset Export at the end. Every stage invokes an existing DC-003 CLI via Execute Command — no business logic is reimplemented in n8n. Approval gates use n8n's native Wait node in form-resume mode (no email/Slack dependency). Rejection at any gate stops the workflow with outcome "rejected"; any CLI/validation/rendering/export failure stops it with outcome "technical_failure" naming the exact stage — no automatic retries anywhere. LIVE rendering only (--live on render-production-package.mjs) is the one live-gated step, following the existing DC-003 Live Verification Gate convention. KNOWN BLOCKER, documented in the DC-005 OC-002 README: the mounted runtime repository (digitally-connected-runtime, on main) does not yet contain I030-I034 — none of the five new CLIs this workflow calls exist there, since those milestones are still on unmerged feature branches. This blocks genuine mock/live execution until resolved. Created directly via the n8n Workflow SDK (create_workflow_from_code) against the live n8n MCP connection, then exported here byte-for-byte from get_workflow_details — not hand-authored JSON, avoiding the class of parameter-placement bugs OC-001 hit when MCP access was unavailable.

parameters.content:
## DC-005 OC-002 — GS01 End-to-End Content Production Workflow

Manual Trigger -> Select Approved Article (GS01, hardcoded) -> I030 Content Ingestion -> I031 Editorial Package -> CEO Approval Gate -> I032 Social Media Package -> CEO Approval Gate -> I033 Production Package -> I034 Live Carousel Rendering (Templated, --live) -> CEO Visual Approval Gate -> Approve Carousel (I014) + Production Asset Export (I021/I026) -> Complete.

Orchestrates existing DC-003 CLIs only via Execute Command — no business logic is reimplemented in n8n. Three real human-in-the-loop approval gates use the native Wait node in form-resume mode. Rejection at any gate stops the workflow with outcome "rejected"; any CLI/validation/rendering/export failure stops it with outcome "technical_failure" naming the exact stage — no automatic retries anywhere.

LIVE rendering only (--live on render-production-package.mjs) — following the existing DC-003 Live Verification Gate convention. See the DC-005 OC-002 README for the full request budget and the known infrastructure blocker.

parameters.command:
=DC003_DIR="/data/dc003-repo-root/Active Projects/DC-003 - Automated Content Generation"
RUN_DIR=/tmp/dc005-oc002-run-{{ $now.toFormat('yyyyLLdd-HHmmssSSS') }}-{{ $itemIndex }}
mkdir -p "$RUN_DIR"
cd "$DC003_DIR"
node tests/validation/content-ingestion.mjs create "{{ $json.sourceReference }}" "/home/node/.n8n/dc003/content-production/ic" > "$RUN_DIR/stdout.log" 2> "$RUN_DIR/stderr.log"
DC005_EXIT_CODE=$?
cat "$RUN_DIR/stdout.log"
echo "DC005_EXIT_CODE=$DC005_EXIT_CODE"
cat "$RUN_DIR/stderr.log" 1>&2

=DC003_DIR="/data/dc003-repo-root/Active Projects/DC-003 - Automated Content Generation"
RUN_DIR=/tmp/dc005-oc002-run-{{ $now.toFormat('yyyyLLdd-HHmmssSSS') }}-{{ $itemIndex }}
mkdir -p "$RUN_DIR"
cd "$DC003_DIR"
node tests/validation/editorial-package.mjs create "{{ $('Parse I030 Result').item.json.ingestedContentId }}" "/home/node/.n8n/dc003/content-production/ic" "/home/node/.n8n/dc003/content-production/ep" > "$RUN_DIR/create.log" 2> "$RUN_DIR/stderr.log"
CREATE_EXIT=$?
if [ $CREATE_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
  cat "$RUN_DIR/create.log"
  echo "DC005_EXIT_CODE=$CREATE_EXIT"
  cat "$RUN_DIR/stderr.log" 1>&2
  exit 0
fi
EP_ID=$(grep -oE 'ep_[A-Za-z0-9]+' "$RUN_DIR/create.log" | head -1)
node tests/validation/editorial-package.mjs inspect "$EP_ID" "/home/node/.n8n/dc003/content-production/ep" > "$RUN_DIR/inspect.log" 2>> "$RUN_DIR/stderr.log"
INSPECT_EXIT=$?
cat "$RUN_DIR/inspect.log"
echo "DC005_EXIT_CODE=$INSPECT_EXIT"
cat "$RUN_DIR/stderr.log" 1>&2

=DC003_DIR="/data/dc003-repo-root/Active Projects/DC-003 - Automated Content Generation"
RUN_DIR=/tmp/dc005-oc002-run-{{ $now.toFormat('yyyyLLdd-HHmmssSSS') }}-{{ $itemIndex }}
mkdir -p "$RUN_DIR"
cd "$DC003_DIR"
node tests/validation/social-media-package.mjs create "{{ $('Parse I031 Result').item.json.editorialPackageId }}" "/home/node/.n8n/dc003/content-production/ep" "/home/node/.n8n/dc003/content-production/sm" > "$RUN_DIR/create.log" 2> "$RUN_DIR/stderr.log"
CREATE_EXIT=$?
if [ $CREATE_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
  cat "$RUN_DIR/create.log"
  echo "DC005_EXIT_CODE=$CREATE_EXIT"
  cat "$RUN_DIR/stderr.log" 1>&2
  exit 0
fi
SM_ID=$(grep -oE 'sm_[A-Za-z0-9]+' "$RUN_DIR/create.log" | head -1)
node tests/validation/social-media-package.mjs inspect "$SM_ID" "/home/node/.n8n/dc003/content-production/sm" > "$RUN_DIR/inspect.log" 2>> "$RUN_DIR/stderr.log"
INSPECT_EXIT=$?
cat "$RUN_DIR/inspect.log"
echo "DC005_EXIT_CODE=$INSPECT_EXIT"
cat "$RUN_DIR/stderr.log" 1>&2
